name: WaitForEventOnSapConcur
label: Wait for an Event on SAP Concur and Resume
description: Pauses and resumes a workflow based on specific events occurring in SAP Concur.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID from SAP Concur App Management.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret from SAP Concur App Management.

fields.name: ExpectedStatus
fields.label: Expected Status
fields.description: Status to wait for (e.g., APPROVED, SUBMITTED).

fields.name: PollingInterval
fields.label: Polling Interval (seconds)
fields.description: How often to check for the event (default: 10 seconds).

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait before timing out (default: 300 seconds).

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on Error
fields.description: If true, workflow continues even if the request fails.

fields.name: EventResponse
fields.label: Event Response
fields.description: The final response when event is detected.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.label: Status Code
fields.description: HTTP status code when event is detected.
